edits.old_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth. On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch
edits.new_string: It is a decision ask naming every open umbrella and every child in flight beneath it, at every depth, whose ruling also decides whether it takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review). On the ruling, or after the campaign where it takes one, it lands at once on its own branch

note: Binding-change paragraph: the decision ask's ruling now also decides whether the change takes a campaign (pointer to umbrellas.md § Review), and landing waits for that campaign when one is taken.
